Metra Consultation Inc. offre des servic: Metra Consultation Inc. provides structural engineering services for the assessment, analysis, design, modification and strengthening of structural elements in existing or proposed buildings. Depending on the scope, services may include load analysis, verification of existing elements, design of beams, columns, walls, foundations and connections, and preparation of signed and sealed drawings, details, calculation notes or reports.

Metra Consultation Inc. provides civil engineering services relating in particular to site drainage, grading, stormwater management, water supply and sewer networks, service connections, site development, parking areas, access routes and related infrastructure. The exact extent of analyses, calculations, drawings and deliverables is defined in the project-specific scope description.

Metra Consultation Inc. provides geotechnical engineering services to characterize soil and rock conditions and supply the parameters and recommendations needed to design proposed works. Depending on the scope, services may include planning and carrying out boreholes, in situ testing, sampling, specified laboratory testing, interpretation of stratigraphy and groundwater conditions, and recommendations for foundations, excavations, fill, drainage and frost protection.

Lorsque requis, le client doit permettre: Where required, the client must provide safe access to the site and supply available documents needed for the services, including the certificate of location, survey plans, topographic surveys, existing drawings and information about known networks and infrastructure.
